summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing record monthly CyPath Lung diagnostic test unit sales, up nearly 300% in April 2026 versus April 2025. The filing is a routine business update on operational performance, not a special situation. No transaction, activist, strategic review, or capital event is described. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 provides preliminary unaudited sales data reflecting accelerating physician adoption. As a purely operational disclosure with no structural corporate event, this filing does not qualify as a special situation category. What to watch: continued sales momentum and potential revenue implications.
